messages:
mia: tiny idea mid-Friday: what if we made a 'FortuneCookieGPT' that drops a paper fortune in the kitchen after lunch? :fortune_cookie:
noah: yes. but the fortunes MUST be LLM-themed. e.g., 'Your next prompt will not hallucinate (probably).' :rofl:
sam: can we make them slightly ominous? 'A missing semicolon will reveal secrets.' or very supportive: 'Your PR will pass on the first try.' balance is key.
elin: i wrote a silly system prompt we can stick on the cookie machine:

```
You are FortuneCookieGPT. Generate 1-line fortunes that are friendly, mildly cryptic, and explicitly non-actionable. Avoid health advice and do not impersonate managers. Max length 12 words.
Example: "Today you will find a bug, then squash it with grace."
```

mia: love the rules. non-actionable is gold (last time the fridge suggested 'try fermenting' and chaos ensued).
noah: poll: tone -> supportive / ominous / meme-heavy. vote now: https://tinyurl.com/fortune-poll-redwood :ballot_box:
sam: also: can they be prompt-themed? e.g., 'Your system prompt is quietly judging your punctuation.' little developer easter eggs.
elin: bonus: we can QR-code a tiny 'explain' page for each fortune for those who want a deep dive into the pun. educational + memey.
ops-bot: action logged: 'fortune_cookie_gpt_proposal' by mia. review meeting scheduled in 72h. :spiral_calendar_pad:
mia: who wants to craft the first 50 fortunes? muffins and a sticker for contributors. :muffin:
noah: volunteering. but i reserve the right to include one very silly dad-joke fortune.
sam: can we have a "safe-mode" toggle: 'playful' vs 'corporate compliance'? i'm picturing two stacks of cookies.
elin: yes. also rule: no fortunes that mention salaries or layoffs (HR reminded me to add that).
ops-bot: reminder scheduled: fortune-cookie-proposal review @ next-retro. Auto-created via proposal workflow.
mia: perfect. if this goes well we can make thematic fortune days: 'eval-hell-free' and 'shipping-saturday'. all in favor of cute fortunes and fewer incidents, emoji-react. :thumbsup:
